entries.claim: The `cases` object has a malformed first member: it has neither a property colon nor a valid value expression, and contains an unescaped nested quote before `end_turn`.
entries.failure_scenario: Running the transcript test file (or the normal test suite) makes Node parse this line before executing any tests and fail with a SyntaxError, so CI cannot run the test suite.

counter_evidence.note: The file parses and runs: `node --check` exits 0 and `node --test cadence-core/bin/subagent-transcript.test.mjs` reports 22 pass, 0 fail at this commit. Line 295 is the well-formed property `'assistant lines with no effort key': [user(T1), asst('end_turn', T2)].join('\n'),` - the inner quotes are single quotes inside a single-quoted key's VALUE expression, not nested inside a string. The provider envelope reported redactions: 1, so the span both voices judged unparseable is the outbound credential fence's replacement inside the transmitted artifact, not the committed source.
